description: This PHP class 'InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand' extends another command class and is responsible for configuring and validating database connection details during installation on an existing database within the OrangeHRM system. It prompts the user for database credentials and checks if the database is empty.

classes.name: InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class for setting up an existing database during installation, handling user prompts, database connection validation, and state management.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name string for CLI invocation.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Handles user prompts for database info, attempts connection, and checks if the database is empty, with validation loops on failure.
